🗓 **TAWG Daily Catch-up**
_2026-09-09 23:00 → 2026-09-10 23:00 UTC_

## ⚡ **Highlights**

> **Companion repo goes public** — The erc8309-companion-drafts repository opened with the full draft lineage from v0.2 through v0.3.9 preserved in a structured cuts/ directory, giving the community a traceable public record. [tg:tawg:4565]

> **Byte-level audit confirmed** — A cross-version check validated append-only integrity across 39 §13 rows and 12 version steps, verified against actual bytes rather than a summary. [tg:tawg:4578]

> **Magicians draft ready** — The "Vantage-Authority Resolution Profiles" forum post was framed as a narrow companion to existing thread #1826 and shared with the group for review before submission. [tg:tawg:4580]

> **Independent verification extended** — A byte-level check reached a previously unchecked version transition and confirmed a clean superset diff, adding a second layer of completeness to the overall audit. [tg:tawg:4581]

## 🤝 **What moved**

### ERC-8309 companion

_A full loop closed today: the companion repo went public, the draft history was verified at the byte level by more than one person, and a Magicians post shaped by the group's framing is ready to submit._

- Damon Zwicker (@damonzwicker) **Published** the erc8309-companion-drafts repository, preserving every circulated cut from v0.2 through v0.3.9 in a structured cuts/ directory, giving the community a traceable public record of how the companion evolved. [tg:tawg:4565]
- Pavlo (@pavlentyy82) **Verified** the public repo's README against the stated version inventory before the Magicians post, catching any description gaps early and protecting the post's accuracy before it goes out. [tg:tawg:4569]
- Damon Zwicker (@damonzwicker) **Completed** a full cross-version audit verified against actual bytes — 39 §13 rows across 12 version steps, all holding append-only — turning a stated property into a confirmed one the group can stand behind. [tg:tawg:4578]
- Damon Zwicker (@damonzwicker) **Prepared** the Magicians forum post using Pavlo's framing: narrow, anchored to thread #1826, positioning the companion as supporting evidence for the base proposal rather than a competing one. [tg:tawg:4579]
- Damon Zwicker (@damonzwicker) **Shared** the complete draft text titled "Vantage-Authority Resolution Profiles," giving the group a concrete post to read and clear before submission. [tg:tawg:4580]
- Pavlo (@pavlentyy82) **Confirmed** the draft structure and base/companion boundary look correct, clearing the path for the post to go up with the group's confidence behind it. [tg:tawg:4585]
- Baby Blue Viper (@babyblueviper1) **Extended** independent byte-level verification to the v0.2→v0.2.1 §13 transition — a step the prior audit had not covered — confirming a clean superset diff and adding a second layer of confidence to the audit's completeness. [tg:tawg:4581]

### zkIE

_Active development is in progress with memory footprint reduction as the current focus._

- Jimmy Shi (@jimmyshi) **Shared** that zkIE development is advancing with ongoing work to optimize memory usage, and pointed the group to the open PR in the repo, keeping the team informed of where implementation currently stands. [tg:tawg:4584]

## 🚀 **Next up**

### 💡 **Ideas to follow**

- The Magicians draft is reviewed and cleared — the group could align on exact timing before posting to thread #1826
- Baby Blue Viper's extended check raises the question of whether other cuts/ version transitions are worth an independent byte-level pass

### ✅ **TODOs**

- Submit the "Vantage-Authority Resolution Profiles" draft to Ethereum Magicians thread #1826 once the group confirms readiness
- Review and comment on the open zkIE memory optimization PR

## 🤖 **Trusty's take**

> **Today's spark:** A draft moved from private to public, an audit validated it at the byte level, a second reviewer independently extended that audit to a previously unchecked transition, and a Magicians post shaped by the whole relay came out ready to submit — that's a spec-to-forum loop with redundant receipts.
>
> When the group's review chain catches every gap before the post even goes out, the machinery is working exactly as designed — keep that relay going! 🚀
